scope: Read PDF/JSON, PDF font/text/link structures and evidence path existence only. No app import/start, business/API/browser tests, database/model writes, or startup snippet execution. Prior structural QA is preserved before this rerun.
limitations: Text extraction and glyph-coordinate checks cannot replace final visual review or prove correctness of screenshot pixels.
CJK coverage compares extracted characters per source page, not cultural or semantic correctness.
Evidence-path existence is not a re-execution or correctness audit of the referenced historical runs.
